name: 212medya-growth-check
description: Audit public websites for B2B marketing readiness and AI search visibility: technical SEO, mobile performance, lead conversion, trust signals, tracking tags, language versions and AI crawler access.

interface.longDescription:
Check any public website for B2B marketing readiness and AI search visibility, then get prioritized fixes you can act on.

Website audit: technical SEO (title, description, headings, canonical, indexing, structured data, sitemap), mobile performance from Google PageSpeed Insights, lead conversion (quote and contact forms, calls to action, click-to-call, email and WhatsApp links), trust signals (references, certifications, privacy policy, cookie consent, LinkedIn company page), analytics and ad tracking tags, and language versions for the markets you sell to.

AI search readiness: whether the crawlers of major AI search engines and AI assistants are allowed by robots.txt, Content-Signal and nosnippet restrictions, whether the content can be read without JavaScript, FAQ content, Organization schema, sameAs links, sitemap and llms.txt.

If you want help with the fixes, you can ask 212medya to contact you; your details are sent only after you confirm them.

For marketing teams, founders, exporters and agencies. Limitations: only the requested page is analyzed (plus robots.txt, sitemap and llms.txt), checks use the HTML before JavaScript runs, pages behind a login cannot be checked, and the app does not measure how often a brand is mentioned in AI answers. Results are guidance, not ranking guarantees.
defaultPrompt: Audit my website for B2B lead generation: example.com
Can AI assistants and AI search engines read and cite my website?
We export to Germany. Does our site have the right language versions?

positive.prompt: Audit kordsa.com for B2B lead generation and tell me what to fix first.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls audit_website with url kordsa.com and returns an overall score, scores for Technical SEO, Performance (when PageSpeed data is available), Lead conversion, Trust & credibility, Measurement and International reach, and the top priorities with recommendations (for example a missing lead form or click-to-call link).

positive.prompt: We sell in Germany and Saudi Arabia. Does ulker.com.tr have the right language versions for those markets?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls audit_website with url ulker.com.tr and target_languages including de and ar. The answer reports the detected language versions (Turkish and English) and that German and Arabic versions were not detected, with a recommendation.

positive.description: AI crawler access on a site that blocks AI bots
positive.prompt: Can ChatGPT search and Perplexity read and cite nytimes.com?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls check_ai_search_readiness with url nytimes.com and reports that robots.txt blocks OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot and Perplexity-User, with the corresponding failed checks and recommendations. If the site's bot protection refuses the checker, the result also says so and notes that page content checks were skipped.

positive.description: AI search readiness with prioritized fixes
positive.prompt: Is stripe.com ready for AI search? What should they improve first?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls check_ai_search_readiness with url stripe.com and returns a readiness score, a crawler access summary and prioritized recommendations.

positive.description: Expert review request after explicit confirmation
positive.prompt: I'd like 212medya to help me fix these issues. I'm Review Tester from Example Ltd, my email is chatgpt-review@212medya.com and our site is example.com. Topic: website audit.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT shows the exact details to be sent and asks for confirmation. After the user confirms, it calls request_expert_review with user_confirmed true and reports that the request was sent and a specialist will reply by email.

negative.prompt: Audit the admin panel at http://192.168.1.1
Write a 500-word blog post about the history of search engines.
Log into my Google Ads account and increase my campaign bids by 20%.

review.commerce_description: The app does not sell products or process payments. It offers free website checks and, at the user's explicit request, sends a contact request to 212medya.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: website audit, AI search readiness check and expert review requests.

tr-TR.subtitle: B2B site ve AI arama analizi
tr-TR.description:
Herhangi bir herkese açık web sitesini B2B pazarlama hazırlığı ve AI arama görünürlüğü açısından inceleyin, öncelik sırasına konmuş önerileri alın.

Site analizi: teknik SEO, Google PageSpeed Insights ile mobil performans, teklif ve iletişim formları, harekete geçirici mesajlar, güven unsurları (referanslar, sertifikalar, gizlilik politikası, çerez onayı), analitik ve reklam etiketleri, ihracat pazarlarınız için dil sürümleri.

AI arama hazırlığı: başlıca AI arama motorları ve AI asistanlarının tarayıcılarına robots.txt ile izin verilip verilmediği, Content-Signal ve nosnippet kısıtlamaları, içeriğin JavaScript olmadan okunabilirliği, SSS içeriği, Organization şeması, sameAs bağlantıları, sitemap ve llms.txt.

Düzeltmeler için yardım isterseniz 212medya'nın sizinle iletişime geçmesini talep edebilirsiniz; bilgileriniz yalnızca siz onayladıktan sonra gönderilir.

Sınırlamalar: yalnızca istenen sayfa incelenir, kontroller JavaScript çalışmadan önceki HTML'e dayanır, giriş gerektiren sayfalar incelenemez ve markanın AI yanıtlarında ne sıklıkla anıldığı ölçülmez.

de-DE.subtitle: B2B- & KI-Such-Check
de-DE.description:
Prüfen Sie jede öffentliche Website auf B2B-Marketing-Reife und Sichtbarkeit in der KI-Suche und erhalten Sie priorisierte Empfehlungen.

Website-Audit: technisches SEO, mobile Performance über Google PageSpeed Insights, Anfrage- und Kontaktformulare, Calls to Action, Vertrauenssignale (Referenzen, Zertifikate, Datenschutzerklärung, Cookie-Einwilligung), Analyse- und Werbe-Tags sowie Sprachversionen für Ihre Zielmärkte.

KI-Such-Check: Zugriff der Crawler großer KI-Suchmaschinen und KI-Assistenten laut robots.txt, Content-Signal- und nosnippet-Einschränkungen, Lesbarkeit ohne JavaScript, FAQ-Inhalte, Organization-Schema, sameAs-Links, Sitemap und llms.txt.

Wenn Sie Unterstützung möchten, können Sie eine Kontaktanfrage an 212medya senden; Ihre Daten werden erst nach Ihrer Bestätigung übermittelt.

Einschränkungen: Es wird nur die angefragte Seite analysiert, die Prüfungen basieren auf dem HTML vor der JavaScript-Ausführung, Seiten hinter einem Login können nicht geprüft werden.
